attribution.description: root-cause rule name, or the failed rule itself when the attribution points at its own judge (oracle side)

fix_owner.description: auto-rebuild target, and the only thing that decides whether this diagnosis routes; ABSENT when the attribution is self-pointing (oracle side) — such a diagnosis is recorded as-is (P4) but escalates instead of auto-rebuilding

provenance.description: the bare identity that vouches for this diagnosis; required when source=human

reason.description: the reasoning behind the attribution; required when source=human, and carried verbatim into the fix owner's dispatch.json. A triage diagnosis has none: its analysis is its own result.json, referenced from evidence.
